sql: WITH pairs AS ( SELECT market_ticker, min(created_at) placed, max(quantity)::float qty, min(limit_price) plo, max(limit_price) phi, bool_or(status='filled') filled FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Alimm1' AND action='buy' AND coalesce(client_order_id,'') NOT LIKE 'limmexit:%' GROUP BY market_ticker, date_trunc('hour', created_at)) SELECT p.market_ticker AS mkt, to_char(p.placed,'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS placed, p.qty::int AS qty, p.plo||'/'||p.phi AS px, p.filled, round(extract(epoch from p.placed - s.at)/60) AS snap_min, round(s.est_yes_score_total::numeric) AS field_y, round(s.est_no_score_total::numeric) AS field_n, pr.target_size::int AS tgt, round(pr.period_reward_usd::numeric,2) AS pool, round((pr.period_reward_usd/ nullif(extract(epoch from pr.end_date - pr.start_date)/86400,0))::numeric,2) AS pool_day, round((100*(p.qty/(s.est_yes_score_total+p.qty) + p.qty/(s.est_no_score_total+p.qty))/2)::numeric,1) AS share_pct, round((pr.period_reward_usd/ nullif(extract(epoch from pr.end_date - pr.start_date)/86400,0) * (p.qty/(s.est_yes_score_total+p.qty) + p.qty/(s.est_no_score_total+p.qty))/2)::numeric,3) AS est_day, round((100*(2000/(s.est_yes_score_total+2000) + 2000/(s.est_no_score_total+2000))/2)::numeric,1) AS share2000_pct FROM pairs p LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM incentive_market_snapshots s WHERE s.market_ticker=p.market_ticker AND s.at <= p.placed AND s.est_yes_score_total IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.at DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM incentive_programs pr WHERE pr.market_ticker=p.market_ticker ORDER BY pr.last_seen_at DESC LIMIT 1) pr ON true ORDER BY p.placed
